world: ONE lit object: a bacterium whose dome fills the lower frame and runs off the bottom edge, in sunlit sea water. A T4-type bacteriophage (cream head packed with magenta DNA, teal contractile sheath, steel tail fibres) lands on it like a lander.

intent.xray: from s2 the cell surface is deliberately translucent so the interior is visible
intent.text: one text system per scene (chips, one stamp, counter plates); title on hook and closer only
intent.timing: rule C18: every event is timed on u (fraction of the line); nothing holds on idle motion

simplifications: only 4 near + 2 far tail fibres drawn clearly (T4 has six long fibres)
human-cell scene is schematic: phages lack receptors for human cells
1 in 5 is Suttle's ~20% of ocean microbial biomass per day, an estimate that varies by system
